ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.

4. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

8. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping home? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping home.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping home.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping home.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping home.

14. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

15. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

16. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Child Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Meeting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise projects environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Exploring and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for plants environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for animals environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
